'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**The [[Pakistani Armed Forces]] launches an operation in [[Bajaur]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], a former stronghold of the [[Pakistani Taliban]], to find insurgent hideouts. Over 100,000 civilians have been [[internal displacement|internally displaced]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-military-offensive-northwest-c7315f68a7eab6a1cfa27e2e05ae6f20 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**[[China]] and the [[United States]] extend their trade truce another 90 days to ease world tension after the international tariffs that went into effect after being [[Liberation Day tariffs|signed on April 2]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-trade-tariffs-china-deadline-ad2c003e9a709a1dfdfc9a9fd3798baf (AP)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/11/us/politics/us-china-trade-tariffs-deal.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2025/08/11/economy/us-china-tariff-extension (CNN)]
*[[Chinese property sector crisis (2020–present)|Chinese property sector crisis]]
**The [[Evergrande Group]] announces it will be [[Delisting (stock)|delisted]] from the [[Hong Kong Stock Exchange]] on August 22 after trading remained suspended for over 18 months following a [[Judiciary of Hong Kong|court]]-ordered [[liquidation]] in January 2024, with the company owing more than US$300 billion and unable to present a viable [[debt restructuring]] plan. [https://www.euronews.com/business/2025/08/12/worlds-most-indebted-company-china-evergrande-delisted-from-hong-kong-stock-exchange (Euronews)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 European and Mediterranean wildfires]]
**A wildfire destroys centuries old chestnut trees and tourist buildings at the [[Las Médulas]] gold-mining site in [[Castilla y León]], Spain. [https://elpais.com/clima-y-medio-ambiente/2025-08-12/las-medulas-un-paisaje-cultural-que-modelaron-los-romanos-y-ahora-cercan-las-llamas.html (''El País'')]
*Nine people are killed and seven others are injured in an explosion at a factory in [[Quatro Barras]], [[Paraná (state)|Paraná state]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp89jr2jz34o (BBC News)]
*A van crashes into a metal fence after losing control on the [[Central Luzon Link Expressway]] near [[Tarlac City]], [[Philippines]], killing five and injuring nine others. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/regionaltv/news/109631/5-dead-9-hurt-in-tarlac-van-crash/story/ (GMA)]
*Four people, including a child, are killed after flash flooding displaces over 100 people and floods homes and businesses in and around [[Chattanooga]], [[Tennessee]], United States. US [[Interstate 24]] is shut down and dozens of rescues are made to people stranded by flood waters along the I24/HWY153 corridor and around [[Hamilton Place (shopping mall)|Hamilton Place Mall]]. [https://newschannel9.com/news/local/flash-flooding-creates-hazardous-road-conditions-shuts-down-i-24-west-in-hamilton-county (WTVC-TV)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israeli settler violence]]
**[[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]] beat [[Palestinian Americans|a Palestinian-American man]] to death in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/07/12/g-s1-77345/israeli-settlers-u-s-citizen-death-west-bank (NPR)]
*A [[Judiciary of Guatemala|Guatemalan court]] sentences six former [[National Civil Police (Guatemala)|police officers]] and child protection officials to prison terms of six to 25 years for homicide, mistreatment of minors, abuse of authority, and breach of duty in connection with a [[2017 Guatemala orphanage fire|2017 fire]] at an orphanage in [[San José Pinula]] that killed 41 girls and injured 15 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/guatemala-sentences-officials-over-2017-shelter-fire-that-killed-41-girls-2025-08-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Indian Police Service|Indian police]] arrest dozens of [[animal rights]] activists protesting at the [[India Gate]] in [[New Delhi]] against the [[Supreme Court of India|Supreme Court]]'s decision to remove over 5,000 [[stray dog]]s from the streets as New Delhi sees nearly 2,000 [[dog bite]]s per day. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-dozens-detained-for-protesting-top-courts-dog-order/a-73615797 (DW)]
*The [[Judiciary of South Korea|Seoul Central District Court]] issues an arrest warrant for former [[South Korea]]n [[First Lady of South Korea|first lady]] and [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]'s spouse [[Kim Keon Hee]] on three charges related to [[market manipulation|stock manipulation]], allegations of [[bribery|accepting luxury gifts]], and illegal political funding during the [[2022 South Korean by-elections|2022 by-election]]. It is the first time in the country's history that a former presidential couple has been taken into custody. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/12/south-korean-court-orders-arrest-of-impeached-former-president-wife-kim-keon-hee (''The Guardian'')]
*In an effort to save the [[Maasai Mara]] reserve in [[Kenya]], an activist files a lawsuit against the [[Ritz-Carlton]], which plans to open a 20-suite safari camp there. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/kenyan-activist-tries-block-new-ritz-carlton-safari-lodge-opening-2025-08-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Red Bull GmbH]] finalizes the complete [[mergers and acquisitions|acquisition]] of the [[Newcastle Falcons]] [[rugby union]] club as its newest venture into another sport, following involvement in [[Association football|football]], [[ice hockey]], [[Formula One]], and [[esports]]. [https://apnews.com/article/red-bull-newcastle-rugby-b2e4a0b65866261d26bcb3f031b8c96b (AP)]
